entries.sourceText: Mother died today. Or, maybe, yesterday; I can't be sure.
entries.translationZh: 母亲今天去世了。也许是昨天，我不能确定。

entries.sourceText: Afterwards it struck me I needn't have said that.
entries.translationZh: 后来我忽然想到，那句话其实没有必要说。

entries.sourceText: For the present, it's almost as if Mother weren't really dead.
entries.translationZh: 此刻，这几乎像是母亲并没有真的死去。

entries.sourceText: I wanted to be in bed, only it was such an effort making a move.
entries.translationZh: 我想躺到床上去，只是连动一下都如此费力。

entries.sourceText: There were others in the world worse off than I.
entries.translationZh: 世上还有处境比我更糟的人。

entries.sourceText: He was walking with carefully measured steps, economizing every gesture.
entries.translationZh: 他谨慎地衡量每一步，节省着每一个动作。

entries.sourceText: I explained that it wasn't despair I felt, but fear—which was natural enough.
entries.translationZh: 我解释说，我感到的不是绝望，而是恐惧——这再自然不过。

entries.sourceText: One always has exaggerated ideas about what one doesn't know.
entries.translationZh: 人总会夸大自己不了解的事物。

entries.sourceText: All my time is spent in watching the slowly changing colors of the sky, as day moves on to night.
entries.translationZh: 我把全部时间用于观看天空缓慢变色，看白昼转入黑夜。

entries.sourceText: When something happens to me I want to be ready for it.
entries.translationZh: 当事情降临到我身上时，我希望自己已经准备好。

entries.sourceText: Mother used to say that however miserable one is, there's always something to be thankful for.
entries.translationZh: 母亲常说，无论一个人多么不幸，总还有值得感激的事。

entries.sourceText: Once you're up against it, the precise manner of your death has obviously small importance.
entries.translationZh: 一旦真正面对死亡，死亡的具体方式显然就不那么重要了。

entries.sourceText: Though I mightn't be so sure about what interested me, I was absolutely sure about what didn't interest me.
entries.translationZh: 即使我不确定自己对什么感兴趣，我却完全确定什么不能引起我的兴趣。

entries.sourceText: And yet none of his certainties was worth one strand of a woman's hair.
entries.translationZh: 然而，他所有的确定性都抵不上一根女人的头发。

entries.sourceText: I laid my heart open to the benign indifference of the universe.
entries.translationZh: 我向宇宙温和的冷漠敞开了心扉。

entries.sourceText: To feel it so like myself, indeed, so brotherly, made me realize that I'd been happy, and that I was happy still.
entries.translationZh: 感到它如此像我、如此亲近，使我明白自己曾经幸福，而且依然幸福。

entries.sourceText: And I, too, felt ready to start life all over again.
entries.translationZh: 而我也感到自己已经准备好重新开始生活。

entries.sourceText: I put my hands behind my head, gaze up, and wait.
entries.translationZh: 我把双手枕在脑后，向上凝望，等待。
